title: Estimation of Continuous-Time Markov Processes Sampled at Random Time Intervals
annotation: Develops estimation of continuous-time Markov processes at random arrivals, including state-dependent intensities. The gamma-clock note instead fixes independent gamma intervals and discards their realized durations; random-time identification itself is classical.

authors: Higham, N. J. and Lin, L.
title: On pth roots of stochastic matrices
annotation: Classifies primary and nonprimary matrix roots and studies stochastic roots, including inverse M-matrices. The gamma-clock note uses principal functional calculus for an exact generator inverse and a Fourier calculation for a four-state alias.
